msg: There will be two different gnomes. I ignored their shape and paid attention to their colour. Each gnome will either be a bright colour like purple and a dull colour like brown. At first just pick any gnome. For example, start with a bright coloured gnome. If the number is 4 or more then stick with bright coloured gnomes until you get 3 or less. Then switch to a dull coloured gnome. If it is also 3 or less then keep switching between the gnomes until you get 4 or more and then stick with that colour group. Be quick and don't loose your mushrooms.
